response.sql:
WITH source_counts AS (
  SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM scanspatial AS ss
  JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = ss.arcref
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
), totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_count,
         AVG(record_count) AS average_count
  FROM source_counts
)
SELECT sc.fundflux,
       sc.record_count,
       CAST(sc.record_count AS REAL) / t.total_count AS share,
       sc.record_count - t.average_count AS above_average
FROM source_counts AS sc
CROSS JOIN totals AS t
WHERE sc.record_count > t.average_count;

assumptions.assumption: A NULL funding source is treated as a funding source group, consistent with grouping by fundflux.
